title: Incorrect error hint for empty envvar
detail: `Option.get_error_hint` appends an `(env var: )` hint when `envvar` is an empty string or an empty list. This produces misleading output such as `Error: Missing option '--units' (env var: )`. The PR intends to suppress the hint for empty envvar values, but the current logic only checks truthiness of `self.envvar`, which is true for empty strings/lists. The hint should be omitted when `envvar` is empty or `None`.

title: Auto‑envvar prefix applied to empty envvar
detail: In `Option.get_help_extra`, the condition `if not envvar and (...)` treats an empty string or empty list as falsy and therefore generates an auto‑envvar prefix. The intended behavior is to apply the prefix only when `envvar` is `None`. As a result, options with `envvar=""` or `envvar=[]` incorrectly display an auto‑envvar hint in the help text. The PR should check `envvar is None` instead of falsy.

title: Avoid empty env var hints
detail: Guard against empty sequences or empty strings so that the error hint does not display an empty or malformed `(env var: )`. Only add the hint when there is at least one non‑empty variable name. (PR-Agent's score: 2 of 10)

title: Safeguard Content-Type header usage
detail: Guard against missing or misspelled `Content-Type` headers by falling back to a default charset. This prevents a `KeyError` and ensures the payload is encoded correctly even when the caller omits the header or uses an unexpected case. (PR-Agent's score: 7 of 10)

title: Missing yield check
detail: The lightweight `contextmanager` implementation does not raise an error when the generator does not yield. In the `__exit__` path where `typ` is None, the loop over `self.gen` will simply finish without raising, returning `False`. The standard library raises `RuntimeError("generator didn't yield")` in this case. This could allow silent failures when a context manager is defined incorrectly.

title: Close generator on normal exit
detail: Ensure the generator is closed even when it yields no values. The current loop only closes the generator if it yields at least one value, leaving it open otherwise. This can lead to resource leaks or unexpected behavior. Add an explicit `self.gen.close()` after the loop and return `False` to signal normal exit. (PR-Agent's score: 8 of 10)

title: Properly initialize and maintain stream list
detail: The `_streams` attribute is intended to hold active `NetworkStream` instances, but the current initialization and subsequent updates are inconsistent. The type annotation uses a forward reference syntax that is not valid for runtime initialization, and the list is later overwritten with a type expression instead of a list. This can lead to runtime errors and stale stream references. Initialize the list properly, keep it as a list of streams, and update it safely when streams close. (PR-Agent's score: 8 of 10)

title: Add missing import and guard against None parent
detail: Import the `Node` type used for type hints and guard against `node.parent.type` being `None`. This prevents potential `AttributeError` when the leaf is at the top level and ensures the function behaves correctly for all node types. (PR-Agent's score: 4 of 10)
